summary: M4-S03 (before-save record-triggered Flow stamping EntitlementId, BusinessHoursId and Priority on Case) passes every molecular test declared for it: both always-on checks (xml parse, manifest consistency) and all three declared checkers (record-triggered-flow-patterns, flow-element-naming-conventions, flow-governance) exit 0, check-outputs reports ok with nothing missing/empty/malformed, and the one declared manual test is a well-formed Given/When/Then naming observable outcomes, so it is deferred to the milestone gate rather than failed or flagged unusable. Status moved built -> tested.
confidence_rationale: Every declared acceptance test either ran to an observed exit code or was correctly classified as manual; both always-on checks completed; check-outputs was ok; no checker was missing and no command test needed the deny-list.

process_observations.observation: The manifest is a clean two-way match: three metadata members (Flow, FlowTest, Settings:Flow) each have exactly one file and each file derives exactly one member, with no wildcard members and no orphaned files.

check_flow_governance.py exited 0 with exactly the two advisories the step's own acceptance-test description predicted in advance (the Flow.settings DX-naming glob gap and the fault-path delegation NOTE), which means the builder anticipated the checker's known false-positive rather than being surprised by it.

check_flow_element_naming_conventions.py reports four W-FAULT-TARGET warnings because every fault path on this before-save flow reconverges on a Decision element instead of a LogFault_<Parent> target; deploy-order.md § 5 U2 already records this as a library gap (no cited skill documents a fault-path shape for a RecordBeforeSave flow, which by rule may contain no recordCreates), not a defect in this artefact. Advisory only, exit 0.

The step's own deploy-order.md § 1 flags the CasePriority value mapping (Severity 1 -> High, Premier -> High, else Medium) as derived rather than answered by any clarification; step-tester does not adjudicate Salesforce design questions, so this UNVERIFIED item is carried forward to the milestone gate unchanged rather than resolved here.
M4-S03 is now tested with zero failures and one manual test deferred to the milestone gate.
process_observations.followup_reason: the step is tested and ready to be documented into the workbook, traceability matrix and deploy-order compilation.
